overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on claim verification with explanation generation as a core NLG task. Human evaluation was conducted for benchmarking purposes, and LLM-as-judge was used only for automated label extraction from model outputs. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and removal of redundant items.
